tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Certificate Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, including development builds. Development and testing environments that need locally issued certificates use self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off, so the same security guarantees apply in every build configuration. HTTPS is likewise required everywhere, with no plaintext HTTP exception.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
